method: bench handoff packet bundling calibration protocol, fit and holdout measurement templates, notebook scenario table, and validation instructions

fit.purpose: Estimate diagnostic response parameters and freeze a bounded model profile.

holdout.purpose: Replay the frozen profile against data collected after the fit file is closed.

protocol.notes: Protocol defines repeatable simulator/bench measurements; it does not claim the current spring-hinge solver is calibrated.

fit.purpose: Estimate diagnostic response parameters and freeze a bounded model profile.

holdout.purpose: Replay the frozen profile against data collected after the fit file is closed.

instruments.claimLabel: required force measurement for contact calibration

phases.description: Measure hardware profile fields and register the cell coordinate frame.
Collect the fit dataset without using any holdout measurements.
Generate and freeze a model profile before holdout collection starts.
Collect a separate holdout file after the model profile is frozen.
Run residual validation and independent split checks before making physical claims.

scenarios.purpose: Measure the local rotating-square dilation response to contraction.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Primary alpha change at the commanded cell with backlash-gated neighbor influence.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

scenarios.purpose: Measure expansion-side travel and check for asymmetric backlash.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Positive alpha response at the commanded cell with smaller expansion command.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

scenarios.purpose: Measure direct vertical actuation and residual neighbor lift.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Commanded cell moves vertically; adjacent observation cell captures pin-hole residual coupling.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

scenarios.purpose: Quantify vertical die-off from one actuated cell into a neighboring cell.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Neighbor height response should decay with clearance, backlash, and graph distance.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

scenarios.purpose: Measure whether adjacent cell commands add linearly or interact through backlash.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Any deviation from summed single-cell responses identifies a programmable-discontinuity interaction.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

scenarios.purpose: Measure collective response of mixed horizontal and vertical actuation.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Cluster field should reveal multi-operator coupling, residual height spread, and reachable directions.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

scenarios.purpose: Verify lock enforcement against commanded alpha and vertical motion.
scenarios.expectedResponse: Locked cell should remain fixed while any neighbor residual exposes compliance leakage.
scenarios.claimLabel: bench protocol step; no physical law claimed until measured

passFailCriteria.residualValidationPass: fit and holdout residual scores do not increase after an applied profile update
passFailCriteria.independentValidationPass: residual pass plus complete train/holdout provenance metadata
passFailCriteria.missingEvidence: must be empty before claiming independent hardware validation
passFailCriteria.physicalClaimLimit: passing this protocol supports calibration bookkeeping only; contact, friction, stiffness, and material laws still require model-specific validation

claimLabels.scenarioRows: experimentally unvalidated physical procedure until performed
claimLabels.formalCoverage: Lean-proven finite coverage predicate, not physical accuracy

limitations: The notebook enforces artifact coverage and provenance fields but cannot prove the lab actually collected independent files.
The protocol is normalized and must be mapped to measured hardware units before physical claims.
Rigid-body contact, friction, stiffness, gravity sag, and actuator-force laws remain uncalibrated.

validationInstructions.fitStep: Fill the fit template first and use it to generate a model profile.
validationInstructions.freezeStep: Assign profileId and profileFrozenAt before collecting holdout measurements.
validationInstructions.holdoutStep: Fill the holdout template in a separate raw file after freezing the profile.
validationInstructions.acceptanceRule: Treat independentValidationPass as meaningful only when residual validation passes and splitMetadata.missingEvidence is empty.

claimLabels.fitTemplate: experimentally unvalidated physical procedure until filled
claimLabels.holdoutTemplate: experimentally unvalidated physical procedure until independently filled
claimLabels.formalCompleteness: Lean-proven finite packet-completeness predicate, not physical accuracy

limitations: The packet separates fit and holdout files but cannot prove laboratory independence by itself.
The templates are blank until real bench measurements replace null values.
Passing simulator residual checks is not a proof of contact, friction, stiffness, gravity, or material physics.
